title: Recursive step for the composed restriction parameter
statement:
Write $\delta(w,l,d) = \dfrac{1}{40w}\left(\dfrac{1}{40l}\right)^{d-2}$ for the composed restriction parameter, with fan-in bound $w$, width parameter $l$, and depth $d$. For natural numbers $w$ and $l$ and any depth $d \ge 3$,
\[
  \delta(w,l,d) = \frac{1}{40w}\,\delta(l,l,d-1).
\]
hypotheses_covered: l a natural number (used as the real width parameter)
